comparables.description: Select Harvests Piangil acquisition (Sunraysia almond orchards) at A$129M for ~4,500 acres

methodology:
Select Harvests is Australia's largest pure-play almond grower. The 22,403-acre planted portfolio expanded from 3-row regional aggregation to 6-row property-level breakdown:

Sunraysia/Vic cluster (12K ac total):
- Carina West (5.5K ac flagship + 50,000 MT/yr processing facility)
- Piangil (4.5K ac acquired 2024 for A$129M = A$28K/acre — most direct internal benchmark)
- Other Sunraysia (2K ac smaller holdings)

SA Riverland cluster (7.4K ac total):
- Loxton (4.5K ac)
- Paringa (2.9K ac)

NSW Riverina cluster: 3K ac

Per-acre FMVs anchor to:
- SHV's own 2024 Piangil acquisition at A$28K/acre
- Colliers Rural + LAWD H1 2025 reports at A$33K/acre for prime Sunraysia ground
- SA water cost differential: SA Riverland prices A$25K/acre vs Sunraysia A$30K to reflect higher SA water entitlement costs

Net debt of A$168M (1H FY25) is meaningful leverage; FY25 strong almond pricing ($10.18/kg vs $7.69 prior) supported A$82M EBITDA on A$398M revenue.
